highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 bumps to Skia m151 and ports several hot color/interop paths to managed C# for lower overhead.
highlights_body: Color conversion, premultiply math, HarfBuzz UTF-8 buffering, and tag parsing all move off P/Invoke and onto zero-allocation managed code, alongside a WASM Emscripten 5.0.6 update and a native resource-leak fix in SKImage.FromEncodedData.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled engine to Skia m151 and merges the intervening upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes.
Removes the unnecessary unsafe modifier from GRContextOptions usage, simplifying consuming code.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak fixed in SKImage.FromEncodedData
bullets.detail: Fixes a native resource leak in the SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) overload.

bullets.lead: Color and pixel math ported to managed C#
bullets.detail: SKColor → SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply now run entirely in managed integer math instead of round-tripping through native calls, and SKColor hex parsing gets a ReadOnlySpan<char> overload.

HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) now uses pooled UTF-8 encoding instead of allocating, Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse drop their per-call char[4] allocation, SKShaper reads glyph results via zero-copy spans, and SKData.SaveTo avoids an extra buffer copy.
Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 and a preview-.NET WASM test job to catch exception-handling regressions.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Ported SKColor/SKColorF conversion, SKPMColor premultiply math, HarfBuzz buffer/tag parsing, and SKShaper glyph reads to allocation-free managed code, plus the SKColor hex-parsing span overloads

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Opened the 4.151.0 line with the release-notes pipeline rework and early groundwork for the managed performance ports.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Landed the managed SKColor/SKColorF conversion and SKPMColor premultiply ports, HarfBuzz allocation-free buffer/tag parsing, and the SKImage.FromEncodedData leak fix.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Bumped to Skia m151, added the WASM Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries, and merged the final round of upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes ahead of the stable release.

harfbuzz_summary: Ports HarfBuzzSharp's UTF-8 buffer encoding and tag parsing to allocation-free managed code, and switches SKShaper glyph reads to zero-copy spans.
